name: Hotel Garni St. Nikolaus
beschreibung: Hotel Garni St. Nikolaus is a welcoming family-run bed-and-breakfast situated in a peaceful location at the entrance to Ischgl. The house features traditional alpine decor and personalised care. In summer, the surrounding Silvretta mountain range provides extensive hiking trails, while winter guests enjoy swift access to premier skiing via the nearby Silvrettabahn. Accommodations include comfortable rooms with balconies, an on-site sauna area, and a daily breakfast buffet.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni St. Nikolaus in Ischgl offers family-run bed-and-breakfast hospitality, a sauna area, balcony rooms, and convenient access to the Silvrettabahn cable car.
